zh.scene.hint.homework: 讲完、讲清就行；论据可以少一点，别超时。
zh.scene.hint.final: 内容要多、结构要清：问题 → 方法 → 结果 → 意义。
zh.scene.hint.contest: 按 12 个 3MT 获奖者的实测画像打分：语速 150–180，停顿短而准，结尾落地。
zh.scene.hint.interview: 宁可短、宁可干净：结论先说，少用软化词。
zh.scene.hint.defense: 内容最重，术语可以保留，语速慢一点没关系。
zh.scene.hint.pitch: 要冲、要有起伏：关键处停顿，把重音砸下去。
zh.tip.fillers: 软化词密度 {rate}/100 词（专业演讲者 0.5–1.9）。like / just / actually / really / pretty 每 17 个词就冒一个，听感发软。
zh.tip.production: 画面 {w}×{h}，中位亮度 {luma}。构图和灯光还能再拿 {lost} 分。
zh.tip.finals: 句尾上扬占 {pct}%（{n}/{total}）。陈述句句尾该往下落，上扬留给问句。
zh.tip.artic: 发音速率 {wpm} wpm，只有真正开口时才这么快，容易连读吃掉辅音。
zh.tip.longest: 最长一句 {sec} 秒。超过 10 秒的句子，观众会丢失主语。
zh.tip.motion: 画面动作幅度 {motion}（专业对镜头演讲者在 9–10）。手势太小，手可能根本没进画。

en.scene.hint.homework: Finish it and be clear; fewer sources is fine, just do not run over.
en.scene.hint.final: More content, clear structure: problem → method → result → why it matters.
en.scene.hint.contest: Scored against 12 measured 3MT winners: 150–180 wpm, short precise pauses, endings that land.
en.scene.hint.interview: Shorter and cleaner wins: answer first, drop the softeners.
en.scene.hint.defense: Content matters most; jargon is allowed; a slower pace is fine.
en.scene.hint.pitch: Drive it: dynamics, pauses before the point, punch the stressed word.
en.tip.fillers: Softener density {rate} per 100 words (professional speakers: 0.5–1.9). A like / just / actually / really / pretty every 17 words makes you sound unsure.
en.tip.production: Frame is {w}×{h}, median luma {luma}. Framing and lighting still have {lost} points in them.
en.tip.finals: {pct}% of sentences end on a rise ({n}/{total}). Statements should fall; save the rise for questions.
en.tip.artic: Articulation rate {wpm} wpm — you only speak that fast when actually talking, so consonants get swallowed.
en.tip.longest: Longest sentence: {sec}s. Past ten seconds, listeners lose track of the subject.
en.tip.motion: Motion {motion} (professional on-camera speakers sit at 9–10). Your gestures are small — your hands may not even be in frame.
